title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions for a comic page, shown going from the sample clip to a comic panel: six of the theme's own (a starburst iris, a red and yellow Ben-Day dot wipe, a black ink slash, a gutter split into panels, a whip smear with speed lines, a page flip on paper stock) and nine from the shared set, drawn in the theme's colours (ink outlines and paper backs on the paper gutter).
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "burst_iris", "seconds": 0.6}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "gutter_split", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.5}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl); this theme's own shaders and its colours for the shared ones are in transitions/theme_transitions.py.

items.name: burst iris
items.description: A jagged burst pops open from the middle: ink outline, a yellow star, a red star inside it, then the next shot, with action lines shooting out. The theme default for a hit.

items.name: Ben-Day wipe
items.description: Ben-Day dots sweep across on a 45-degree screen: yellow dots with an ink rim swell until they join, red dots swell inside them, and the next shot grows out of each.

items.name: ink slash
items.description: A slash of black ink whips down the diagonal with speed teeth and flung drops, a dotted yellow stripe riding in it; the next shot is behind it.

items.name: whip smear
items.description: A whip pan: the shot is thrown off sideways, skewed and smeared, the next thrown in behind it, with ink and paper speed lines.

items.name: zoom through
items.description: A crash zoom: the camera rushes through the picture into the next one, the whip between panels.

items.name: shatter
items.description: The picture breaks into pieces that tumble toward the camera, centre first: the hit that ends a scene.

items.name: gutter split
items.description: The frame comes apart along two angled gutters into three inked panels that slide off to alternate sides, each throwing a hard ink shadow.

items.name: panel wipe
items.description: An angled panel edge crosses the frame: ink line, paper gutter, ink line, with the old panel nudged aside.

items.name: panel slide
items.description: Four angled panels of the next shot slide in from alternating sides, each with its gutter and ink outline.

items.name: slice slide
items.description: The picture is cut into strips that tilt and slide off to alternate sides, like a page torn into tiers.

items.name: tile flip
items.description: A grid of panels turns over in a diagonal wave; the next shot is printed on the back of each.

items.name: cube spin
items.description: The two shots are faces of a box that turns a quarter of the way round on the paper page, inked along its edges.

items.name: page flip
items.description: The page flips up from its top edge toward the camera, bottom edge curling, inked round its rim, paper on the back.

items.name: page turn
items.description: The page lifts from its corner, curls over and folds away, leaving the next page underneath.

items.name: swing doors
items.description: The picture splits down the middle and opens like a gatefold spread onto the next shot.
